name: The Loom Keeper
notes: Yellow Guardian, redesigned Nov 25 (Jay: it must not feel like the tutorial boss). Darkness over the tailor's loom (Story of the Light v2: a Guardian is never a person). It fights from a distance: after each attack it glides away (keepAway). Spool Toss: a red circle thrown onto the player, then the spool comes back for a second hit; a Great Counter on the return knocks it dizzy. Threads (dash-only lines wall to wall) snap and lie on the floor for a while, slowing walking but never hurting. At half health it rises to its loom: three Spool Pegs appear around the room and it can't be hurt until they are broken, then it tumbles down dizzy. From a third: the Big Cloth and crossing threads. No Swarmers. Numbers are tuned by the balance tests.

attacks.name: spool toss
attacks.tell: It throws the spool; a red circle under the hero. The spool comes back: a second red circle. Counter either; Countering the return knocks it dizzy.

attacks.name: thread line
attacks.tell: A striped thread wall to wall through the hero, '!!' and a twang. It snaps and lies on the floor for 4 s: walking over it is slow.

attacks.name: crossing threads
attacks.tell: Threads across, then up and down, one at a time; each lies on the floor for 4 s.

attacks.name: big cloth
attacks.tell: A dark cloth over the hero's side of the room; its edge glows for 1.5 seconds.

phases.tell: It throws its spool and pulls threads across the room.
phases.counterplay: COUNTER the spool; DASH off threads.
phases.senseiLine: The spool goes up first. Ready.

phases.tell: Up on its loom; three glowing spools appear.
phases.counterplay: Break the spools while dodging threads.
phases.senseiLine: Break the three spools. Then it falls!
phases.senseiLineDraft: Claude's draft, waiting on Jay's OK

phases.tell: The coat tears; the cloth's edge glows.
phases.senseiLine: Watch the glowing edge. Stay bright.

senseiAtDoor: Someone used to sew warm things here.
senseiAfterWin: Warm things are made to be shared.

lines.intro: Someone used to sew warm things here.
lines.freed: Take a blanket. Someone out there's cold.
lines.freedBy: Miss Ada, the tailor, in town (draft name)
lines.senseiAfter: Warm things are made to be shared.

description: The Loom Keeper throws its spool like a yo-yo, pulls sticky threads across the room, climbs onto its loom behind three glowing spools, then slides a big dark cloth over your side.

bestiary.tip: Counter the spool when it comes back!

lore.yellow: Darkness settled on the tailor's loom and took her shape. It weaves grey cloth that warms no one.
